<abbr title="Koh-Lanta: The Immunity Hunters">'''''Koh-Lanta: Les Chasseurs d'Immunité'''''</abbr> is the thirtieth season of ''[[Koh-Lanta]]''.

After 38 days, [[Léa Sahin]] defeated [[Meïssa Seck]] in a 8-3 [[jury]] vote to become the [[Sole Survivor]].
==Production==
{{Empty section}}
==Twists/Changes==
*'''[[Hidden Immunity Idol|Hidden Immunity Necklaces]]:''' Numerous necklaces are hidden at both [[camp]]s, each having different powers:
**Some necklaces can protect one or two castaways as chosen by the holder, but not the holder themselves. These necklaces have to be played at the first [[Tribal Council]] after which they were found.
**Another type of necklace does not grant immunity but gives the illusion of doing so. Needing to be played for another player before the votes are read, this necklace secretly casts two extra votes against the recipient.
** Another type of necklace grants immunity to the holder and one other person.
** Another type of necklace grants immunity to one person up until and including the first Tribal Council after the [[Merged Tribe (Les Chasseurs d'Immunité)|merge]].
* '''Jokers:''' On Day 4, two new castaways entered the game. The [[tribe]] that finished first in the [[Reward Challenge]] would get to choose which one would join them, the tribe that finished last gets the remaining castaway.
*'''Sudden Death Challenge:''' During the third Reward challenge, every castaway competed individually. The winner of the challenge won rice for his tribe as well as a clue to an Hidden Immunity Necklace. The first two castaway to lose the challenge from the losing tribe would compete in a Duel with the loser being eliminated immediately.
*'''[[Tied Destinies (twist)|Tied Destinies]]:''' On Day 27, the ten remaining castaways were randomly divided into five pairs. Until the next Tribal Council, the fate of each castaway is linked to their partner; they will compete in the challenges in pairs, and the castaway voted out at Tribal Council also causes their partner's elimination.
*'''Change of Camp:''' On Day 35, the six remaining castaways changed camps because a cyclone was forming, which rendered their current camp too risky. A shelter was already constructed at the new camp.
